## Summary

Describe the change and the user value it delivers.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Functional smoke test completed
- [ ] No secrets or local environment files included

## Decision-first review

- [ ] Business logic remains outside React components
- [ ] The change saves time, reduces errors, or improves decisions
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when required
